description: This file defines the Language class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, responsible for retrieving and caching language data from the database, including language details and associated images.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Model class for handling language data, including retrieval by ID or code, and fetching all active languages with caching.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a language record by its ID, including constructing the image URL based on extension and code.

methods.name: getLanguageByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a language record by its code, including constructing the image URL.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Fetches all active language records, utilizing caching, and constructs image URLs for each language.
